CEREMONIALBEAST-CEREMONIAL_SOIL.title: Ceremonial Soil
CEREMONIALBEAST-CEREMONIAL_SOIL.descript: At the start of combat, add {CardsCount:diff()} [gold]Ceremonial Plowing[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
CEREMONIALBEAST-CEREMONIAL_SOIL.flavor: Soil darkened by rites too old to name.
CEREMONIALBEAST-CEREMONIAL_DAGGER.title: Ceremonial Dagger
CEREMONIALBEAST-CEREMONIAL_DAGGER.descri: The first time you enter [gold]Ringing[/gold] each combat, gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
CEREMONIALBEAST-CEREMONIAL_DAGGER.flavor: A worn blade, blunt with age and still sharp with purpose.
CEREMONIALBEAST-HEAVY_SHACKLES.title: Heavy Shackles
CEREMONIALBEAST-HEAVY_SHACKLES.descripti: At the start of combat, enchant [blue]2[/blue] unenchanted cards in your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] with [gold]Inspire[/gold]. Prefers cards that cost Energy.
CEREMONIALBEAST-HEAVY_SHACKLES.flavor: They once bound an unnamed beast. Now they bind fortune to your hand.
CEREMONIALBEAST-BLOODY_TOTEM.title: Bloody Totem
CEREMONIALBEAST-BLOODY_TOTEM.description: At the start of your turn, deal damage to ALL enemies equal to your [gold]Plow[/gold].
CEREMONIALBEAST-BLOODY_TOTEM.flavor: Old blood sits deep in the grain, still answering the earth.
CEREMONIALBEAST-BLESSED_SOIL.title: Blessed Soil
CEREMONIALBEAST-BLESSED_SOIL.description: While you have [blue]50%[/blue] HP or less, enemy damage you take is reduced by [blue]20%[/blue].
CEREMONIALBEAST-BLESSED_SOIL.flavor: A warm handful of soil that seems to breathe when hope runs thin.
CEREMONIALBEAST-OLD_PLOWSHARE.title: Old Plowshare
CEREMONIALBEAST-OLD_PLOWSHARE.descriptio: At the end of your turn, [gold]Retain[/gold] enchanted cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
CEREMONIALBEAST-OLD_PLOWSHARE.flavor: Its edge is bent, but it still knows how to open stubborn ground.
CEREMONIALBEAST-PALE_ANTLER.title: Pale Antler
CEREMONIALBEAST-PALE_ANTLER.description: Your [gold]Plow[/gold] is reversed: gain temporary [gold]Dexterity[/gold] and lose the same amount of temporary [gold]Strength[/gold] instead.
CEREMONIALBEAST-PALE_ANTLER.flavor: Once worn by a noble white stag, now cold and smooth as moonlit bone.
CEREMONIALBEAST-BEAST_BONE_FRAGMENT.desc: Whenever you lose {HpThreshold:diff()} HP, gain {MaxHpGain:diff()} Max HP.
CEREMONIALBEAST-BEAST_BONE_FRAGMENT.flav: Deep tooth marks cross the bone, and something living still lingers inside.
CEREMONIALBEAST-FORTIFIED_CEREMONIAL_SOI: Replaces [gold]Ceremonial Soil[/gold]. At the start of each of the first {Turns:diff()} turns of combat, add {CardsCount:diff()} [gold]Ceremonial Plowing[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
Fed by blood and sweat, this soil answers with startling vitality.
CEREMONIALBEAST-ANCIENT_TOOTH.title: Ancient Tooth
CEREMONIALBEAST-ANCIENT_TOOTH.descriptio: Replace [gold]{StarterCard}[/gold] with [gold]{AncientCard}[/gold]. It keeps upgrades and enchantments.
CEREMONIALBEAST-ANCIENT_TOOTH.flavor: An old tooth polished smooth by ritual and time.
